execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expense" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "groupId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "payerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "splitType" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "expense_splitType_check_83a3d92c" CHECK ("splitType" IN ('EQUAL', 'EXACT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenseSplit" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "expenseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."friendRequest" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "receiverId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "senderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "friendRequest_status_check_904c6455" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."friendship" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "user1Id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user2Id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."group" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creatorId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."groupMember" (
  "groupId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."otpVerification" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "otpHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."settlement" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "payerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "receiverId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
